author: SDRenaissance
text_post: Ehh, it all depends on the woman.  I wouldn't over think it too much though.  Just message them and for the most part if your interaction is going well they respond to you.  If for some reason the interaction drops off YOU can always re-inititate things some time (Hatch posted an article I wrote about that on this forum somewhere).  So either way you should be controlling and steering the interaction.  Of course some girls will message you on their own but don't count on it (just like you don't count on a beautiful woman just walking up to you and telling you she's ready to go, right?)

text_post: thank you for this observation. I know that they wont come to you as in msg first, but sometimes i expect them to initiate a conversation. The thing is i feel that if i initiate too many i will look clingy.

author: SDRenaissance
text_post: Ahhh, well if it feels like you're initiating too may conversations that could mean you're loosing them because they are choosing not to respond.  If that is so then you need to dial back and not initiate so many.  For the most part I will re-initiate only a handful of times before I drop it.  Usually I advise people to try it once or twice and then just move on.  It's usually easier to find new girls than salvage old ones.
